name: +1 Animal Speed Escape
desc:
🐮 Welcome to +1 Animal Speed Escape! 
Train your speed on treadmill, play through different obstacles, and make it to the end!

How to Play:
🦁 - Equip an Animal
⚡ - Train on Treadmill for SPEED
🤠 - Play through different obstacles
🦖 - Buy new Animals 
⭐ - Upgrade!

🎁 Join our community BlockTurns for 10,000 FREE SPEED!
